## GSA per diem (FY<year>, from gsa.gov, looked up <date>)
Locality: **<locality / county>**

| Item | Rate |
|---|---|
| Lodging cap, <month> (per night, before taxes) | $<cap> |
| M&IE full day | $<mie> |
| M&IE first/last travel day (75%) | $<mie × 0.75> |

**Max allowable**
- Lodging: nights × $<cap>. Taxes go in the lodging line's Tax box.
- M&IE: 75% on the first day (from home) + full days + 75% on the last day (to home). A site-to-site day is 100% of the new site's rate.
